messages:
Ravi (PM): Quick idea 1: create a 'lightpath' onboard flow for low-risk models: short validation + optional tenant pinning. Purpose: unblock faster entries while keeping safety nets. Thoughts?
Zoe (ML Eng): Like it. Propose 3-day smoke (shadow), 10-day micro canary (3% traffic), bench gates: latency_p95 <= 130ms, eval F1 >= 0.88, token-cost <= 1.2x. Add tokenization parity <= 2.5%.
Marco (Infra): Add hardware whitelist + canary isolation. We should assign autoscale floor and a suppress rule to pause canaries on infra incidents. I'll add job/lightpath-canary v1.
Jules (CS): Customer ask: short pin TTL (45d) with explicit migration checklist. Also require per-tenant opt-in; show pin status in Console.
Nora (Sales): I'll get a short AE blurb: "45-day enterprise pin available; beyond that needs contract." Can ping legal.
Legal-bot: Flag: standard pin blurb template available. Submit for review via legal-requests.
Zoe (ML Eng): Draft flow YAML:
```
flow: lightpath
smoke_days: 3
micro_canary_days: 10
traffic_micro_pct: 3
bench_gates:
  latency_p95_ms: 130
  eval_f1_min: 0.88
  cost_multiplier_max: 1.2
  token_parity_pct_max: 2.5
pinning:
  tenant_opt_in: true
  ttl_days: 45
  auto_renew: false
  escape: rollback-to-stable
```
Marco (Infra): I'll ensure regions us-west-2 + eu-west-1, hardware tags [g5.xlarge]. Add dashboard + alert rule. ETA Thurs.
Jules (CS): I'll draft the migration checklist with stepwise unpin ramp (0->10% over 14d) and a customer comm template. ETA Mon.
Ravi (PM): Owners for final GO: PM + ML Eng + Infra + CS. If any veto, hold. Action items assigned. Sync scheduled next Tue 30m.
